# ROGLayer { #dyf.ROGLayer }

```python
ROGLayer(depth, similarity_threshold, node_indices, n_nodes, n_edges, coverage)
```

A single layer in the ROG hierarchy.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name                 | Type                                     | Description                             |
|----------------------|------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------|
| depth                | [int](`int`)                             | Recursion depth (0 = root layer)        |
| similarity_threshold | [float](`float`)                         | Threshold used for this layer           |
| node_indices         | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`) | Global indices of nodes in this layer   |
| n_nodes              | [int](`int`)                             | Number of nodes                         |
| n_edges              | [int](`int`)                             | Number of edges                         |
| coverage             | [float](`float`)                         | Fraction of input covered by this layer |
